author: creativeleadscommunity
title: Independent game studio seeks Principal Environment Artist
content:
Independent game studio seeks a 👤 Principal Environment Artist (Remote, United States)
An independent game developer and publisher known for multiplayer and shooter titles is expanding its environment art team for a new project.
Create props, architecture, terrain, textures and materials, from white-box levels through final set dressing and lighting. Requires 7+ years of game development experience, multiple Unreal Engine titles, strong PBR and environment art skills, advanced Maya/Max, Photoshop and ZBrush knowledge, plus mentoring experience.
🚀 Interested? 👉 Link in bio
